Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [I returned the same piece 3 times…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a31e03af38714191c85c1f7)
I specified a beautiful entry cabinet furniture furniture piece for a client that we had to send back three times. All of the pieces were damaged or discolored. How embarrassing and how frustrating for my client. I expected way more from Lulu and Georgia. There seems to be no quality control, and obviously the prices are inflated for the products that they are sourcing from manufacturers.

June 4, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jun 18, 2026

Hi there,

Thank you for your feedback! We sincerely apologize for the ongoing issues with the sideboard you ordered. We have shared your concerns with our internal teams to enhance our quality control processes and prevent future damages. In the meantime, our Trade support team has arranged a free return and a full refund for the sideboard. Thank you for your understanding.

Lulu and Georgia
